A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<table><tr><td><img src=\"a.svg\" alt=\"A\"> <a href=\"/1\">x</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/3\">z</a></td></tr></table>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result$content)
```
